latin_text: Since much about the angelic and invisible nature has been handed down by the ancient Hebrews and much also by Dionysius, it was my plan to expound the words of Moses according to the teaching of both schools.
english_translation: Since much about the angelic and invisible nature has been handed down by the ancient Hebrews and much also by Dionysius, it was my plan to expound the words of Moses according to the teaching of both schools.
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico explicitly announces his methodological commitment: since the ancient Hebrews and Dionysius both transmitted profound teachings on angelology, he will expound Genesis according to *both schools simultaneously*. [INFERRED] This is not eclectic borrowing but systematic synthesis: Kabbalah and Pseudo-Dionysius teach the same angelological truths in different symbolic languages.

The philosophical function is hermeneutical and theological: it establishes that Christian and Jewish mysticism converge on angelic reality. Kabbalistic Sefiroth correspond to Dionysian angels; Hebrew letter-mysticism corresponds to angelic intellections. [INFERRED] This justifies Pico's integration: reading Genesis Kabbalistically AND Dionysianly reveals the full angelic architecture.

[VERIFIED] All subsequent Kabbalistic layer entries develop this synthesis. Commento (C.3.4-C.3.5) articulates the three-fold reading method. Oration demonstrates practical synthesis. Being & Unity grounds it metaphysically: participated being expresses itself through all mystical traditions.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.P.1 | Synthesis of Kabbalistic and Dionysian angelologies
